title: Who writes there?
description:
Log every write to watched addresses during a simulated run, like a memory breakpoint.

```
watch 0x5000 (4 bytes)
step 12: 0x1210 wrote 0x5000 = 100
step 40: 0x1388 wrote 0x5000 = 99
writes to 0x5002 overlap the watch -> reported too
```
hints: Two ranges overlap when `a < b + bSize && b < a + aSize` (lesson 3.03).
A `std::map<std::uint64_t, std::vector<Write>>` keyed by `ip` does the grouping.
requirements: Writes are `(step, instruction address, target, size, value)`.
A write overlaps a watch when the two ranges share any byte.
Group the log by the instruction that wrote, to find the code that changes the value.
stretch: Watch reads too and show which code reads the value just after each write.
